statement:
∀ (b : ℕ) [NeZero b] (k : ℤ),
  (∑ u : (ZMod b)ˣ, ZMod.stdAddChar ((k : ZMod b) * (↑(u⁻¹) : ZMod b))) =
    ∑ d ∈ (Nat.gcd b k.natAbs).divisors, (d : ℂ) * (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (b/d) : ℂ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0092 · 计算较小模数完全化的零频 Ramanujan 和
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0092 · Compute the zero frequency of the completed inverse sum as a Ramanujan sum

brief.zh: 单位求逆给置换，故零频可由互素条件的 Möbius 反演计算。保留 k=0 和合数 b。该式为按 a 重排后的零频提供精确基准。
brief.en: Inversion permutes the units, so expand the coprimality condition by Möbius inversion. Include k=0 and composite b. This gives the exact zero frequency after reindexing by a.
